subject: Invoice anchoring & triggered release — Milestones and reconciliation cadence
content:
From: Michael Chen <mchen@brightline.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounting (Brightline) <billing@brightline.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract milestones / invoicing approach

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Finance here is pushing for a cleaner way to handle the annual prepay tied to our commitment: they want a single anchoring invoice at contract kick (covering the first two milestones), then smaller triggered releases tied to usage + milestone acceptance. VAT is a concern — we need to be able to provide VAT invoices that map to milestone releases, and our AP team requires the invoice number to match the DocuSign SOW reference. I attached a proposed milestones spreadsheet (Brightline_Milestones_v2.xlsx) — can Redwood confirm the invoice anchoring approach and the cadence you’d expect for partial releases? Also, please confirm whether Redwood can issue EU-format VAT invoices (we have EU subsidiaries).

Appreciate a quick confirmation.

Best,
Michael Chen
Head of Finance, Brightline Analytics

---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <mchen@brightline.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract milestones / invoicing approach

Michael — thanks for the note and the spreadsheet. Confirm Redwood can do the anchored invoice + triggered release model. High-level proposal:

- Anchor invoice at contract execution (covers Milestone 1: Onboarding + first 3 months capacity and Milestone 2: Production uplift reserve). This invoice will carry the primary invoice number that maps to the SOW.
- Triggered releases: smaller invoices issued when Brightline triggers each milestone acceptance (we’ll issue invoices with incrementing suffixes: e.g., BRI-2028-047 / 01, / 02).
- VAT handling: we can generate EU VAT-format invoices if you provide the customer VAT IDs and the billing entity. For inter-company flows we’ll route via Redwood EMEA entity and include VAT lines as required.
- Reconciliation cadence: monthly drawdown statement + quarterly milestone reconciliation. We’ll provide a CSV export that matches the Brightline_Milestones_v2.xlsx columns so your AP can auto-match.

Can you confirm the expected acceptance criteria for Milestone 3 (scale 10k qps) so we can bake the trigger definition into the invoice workflow? I’ll loop in Marissa (billing ops) to draft the actual invoice numbering pattern and the ledger entries.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Contract milestones / invoicing approach

Vivek / Grace — looping in details from ops:

- Invoice anchor structure: we prefer anchor = 60% of committed annual prepay (rounded to currency unit), with subsequent triggered invoices covering the remaining 40% distributed across milestone releases. This avoids large multiple small wires and keeps AP-friendly matching.
- Numbering: primary invoice BRI-2028-047; releases will be BRI-2028-047-R1, -R2, etc. If Brightline needs DocuSign exact reference included in the header we can populate the SOW ref field.
- VAT evidence: need copy of Brightline VAT registration + country of establishment per billing entity. For EU VAT we’ll need VAT numbers for both payer and Redwood EMEA entity to apply reverse-charge if applicable.
- Drawdown tracking: we’ll publish a monthly CSV with columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, amount_anchor, amount_released, remaining_commitment, usage_tokens, VAT_amount, ledger_tag. Attached: suggested export template and a mock seeded with your milestones.

Attaching Signed_SOW_BRI-2028-047.pdf and our export template.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Signed_SOW_BRI-2028-047.pdf (application/pdf), Brightline_Milestones_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

---
From: Michael Chen <mchen@brightline.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract milestones / invoicing approach

Thanks Marissa — that structure looks fine. A couple of follow-ups from AP:
1) Can the anchor invoice be split into two ledger lines (Onboarding vs Capacity reserve) so we can code to two internal cost centers?
2) For the triggered releases, we need an acceptance email from our engineering manager to count as "milestone accepted". Can Redwood accept a 2-email acceptance pattern (engineering confirmation + PM sign-off) and tie the invoice trigger to the PM sign-off timestamp?

I’ll attach Brightline VAT numbers after this note. Expecting to send the VAT list by EOD.

-Michael

---
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <mchen@brightline.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 11:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract milestones / invoicing approach

Michael — we can support both asks. Operational notes:

- Anchor invoice will include two ledger lines (Onboarding / Capacity reserve). We’ll include the GL tags in the CSV export so Brightline can map to cost centers.
- Trigger logic: Redwood will accept the PM sign-off email as the single canonical trigger to create the triggered invoice. Engineering confirmation is useful but we will require the PM sign-off (email chain with explicit "accepted") before we auto-generate the invoice. We will auto-start a 5-business-day invoice generation window from that timestamp.
- VAT: once we receive VAT IDs we’ll confirm if reverse-charge applies; if not, we’ll bill with Redwood EMEA VAT lines.

I’ll draft a compact runbook and drop it in shared Drive for the team to test the first two triggers.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Billing Operations, Redwood Inference

---
From: Michael Chen <mchen@brightline.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 16:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract milestones / invoicing approach

All — confirmed. We’ll:
- Send VAT numbers and EU billing entity this afternoon.
- Use PM sign-off as the trigger for invoice generation (Brightline PM team will include the SOW ref in the sign-off).
- Request the anchor invoice to be split into two ledger lines.

Thanks for the clear runbook — we’ll be ready for the first release next week.

Best,
Michael
Accounting — Brightline Analytics

End of thread
